---
name: Feature request
about: Something Mnemosyne OS, a package or the CLI should do and does not
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: yaka0007
---

## Which part

Desktop app, a package (`@mnemosyne_os/...`), the MnemoForge CLI, a cartridge,
the website.

## The problem

What you are trying to do, and where it stops today.

## What you would like

What should happen instead. An example of the command, the click or the
sentence you would type helps more than a description.

## What you tried instead

Workarounds, other tools, anything that partly works.

## Anything else

Screenshots, mockups, links.
